A-grouse-drive-0103.name: By Allen Creek
A-grouse-drive-0103.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).

evidence.t: Road: Hart Ridge FSR, 4.8 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS).
2 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
3 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 3-17, Region 3 Thompson. Near the MU line: check the MU map.
Spot is inside an ATV (all terrain vehicle) for Hunting Closed Area: Elephant Hills. Closed September 1 to December 10. Synopsis map 7-4/23.
Route crosses private land (ParcelMap BC, updated 2026-09-25): get permission first or go around.
Private land right here: no shooting within 100 m (109 yd) of an occupied house or farm building (synopsis page 10, 99%).
Hwy 97 right here: no hunting or shooting on or across the road allowance of a numbered highway or 2 lane public road, 15 m (16 yd) each side of the centre line (synopsis page 10, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: youth only: hunters under 18 (page footnote); New, printed green
MU 3-17 is not listed in the Region 3 sharp tailed grouse rows (my reading of the table).

plan: Drive: from Heffley Creek, about 116 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 5 (Yellowhead Hwy), Old Hwy 5, 7th St, Fortune Dr.
Park: 50.9869, -121.51601, pull off on Hwy 97 (paved road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Hart Ridge FSR stretch, 4.8 km one way. About 96 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-17, Region 3. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-03, private land 2026-09-25, closures 2026-10-03.
